# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1120
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1120
- **Title**: gh-1114 SM: layered tick order + merge-first capacity — freshness before verdicts, merge path reserved (minimal, no semantic changes)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1114` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +1270
- **Deletions**: -50
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T19:27:28Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T19:33:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1114
### What changed
Layered the SM tick (gh-1114): `sm_github.json` rules now run in layers — L0 hygiene → **L1 freshness** (unarm-stale / silent-update / park-reset) → L2 verdict (merge / fail / arm / sweep) → L3 dispatch → L4 agents → L5 close — so a head that this tick's freshness rules moved can never be judged by verdicts that read the superseded head (live #435 false park). Added a merge-first capacity reservation so agent lanes can no longer outrun the approved merge path under the workflow cap.

### Key decisions
- New pure leaf module `js/common/smRuleLayers.js`: rule-id → layer map, verdict-action set, merge-path predicate, `mergeReservedSlots`/`reservationFor` math (hoisted require, gh-823 rule)
- `movedThisTick` guard (AC7/AC12): only verified moves record (fresh post-push `github_get_pr` read — E1/E4); DRY ticks never record or claim deferrals (E3); fresh (non-approved) validations keep today's same-tick flow
- L1→L2 boundary drops the `openPrs` ioCache so verdict queries re-read current heads
- Merge-first capacity (AC9-13): reservation held upfront from the dispatch budget; released unused at the L3 boundary (I7) or fully after a merge; in gh-837 parallel mode it equals `validationMutexMax`; `jobParams.mergeReservedSlots: 0` restores today's behavior bit-for-bit (jira-mode ticks never reserve)
- Rule order moved exactly one rule class (unarm-stale-validation into L1, ahead of merge-validated — disjoint query sets, no merge lost); #682/#637/red-yields-slot/gh-994 relative orders preserved and pinned by tests

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smTickLayers.json   # UT-1/AC6 layer-map suite (new)
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json            # full suite: 4764 passed, 0 failed
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  R["sm_github.json rules"] --> L["smRuleLayers.js layer map"]
  L --> T["SM tick (action)"]
  T --> L1["L1 freshness: unarm / silent-update / park-reset"]
  L1 -->|"head moved → tickMovedPrs + openPrs cache drop"| L2["L2 verdict: merge / fail / arm / sweep"]
  L2 -->|"movedThisTick → defer (AC7)"| L3["L3 dispatch: validate-armed before fresh (AC13)"]
  L3 -->|"reservation released / spent"| L4["L4 agent legs (capacity-aware)"]
  L4 --> L5["L5 close"]
```
</details>

+/**

+ * sm_github.json tick, plus the merge-first capacity math.
+ *
+ * The SM tick runs in layers (relative order inside each layer = the
+ * sm_github.json order):
+ *
+ *   L0 hygiene    rerun-cancelled-checks, rerun-any-cancelled-checks,
+ *                 reconcile-*                          (no head moves)
+ *   L1 freshness  unarm-stale-validation, silent-update-behind, park-reset
+ *                 (heads may move here — silent branch refreshes)
+ *   L2 verdict    merge-validated, fail-validation, rework-on-red-gate-unlatched,
+ *                 rework-on-validation-failed, sweep-stale-validating
+ *   L3 dispatch   validate-armed/-fresh/-masked-green, revalidate-armed(-green),
+ *                 validated-green
+ *   L4 agents     conflict-rework … review-on-issue-label
+ *   L5 close      close-on-merge
+ *
+ * Freshness before verdicts: a head this tick's L1 rules moved carries no
+ * checks yet, so an L2 verdict read against the superseded head is a false
+ * verdict (live epam/dmtools-dart#435: fail-validation re-parked a PR on a
+ * stale head seconds before silent-update-behind moved it). smAgent guards
+ * the L2 actions with the tick's movedThisTick set and drops the openPrs
+ * ioCache on the L1→L2 boundary so verdict queries read current heads.
+ *
+ * Merge-first capacity (owner directive 2026-10-19): one workflow slot
+ * (jobParams.mergeReservedSlots, or the whole gh-837 parallel width) is
+ * reserved for the approved merge path. L4 dispatch rules and fresh
+ * validations may spend only cap − reserved until L3 has decided for the
+ * merge candidate; an unused reservation is released to agent legs in the
+ * same tick (no idle cap).
+ *
+ * UT-1 (gh-1114 AC6) pins this map against sm_github.json: every deployed
+ * rule id must appear here with its layer, and the file order must be
+ * non-decreasing by layer — adding a rule without registering it FAILS the
+ * suite. Both the file and this map live in the same repo on purpose.
+ *
+ * GraalJS constraints: var declarations, plain functions, JSON-safe data.
+ */

+var LAYER_ORDER = ['L0', 'L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'L4', 'L5'];

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          e…

Let me compute the cyclomatic complexity of `mergeReservedSlots`:

``
function mergeReservedSlots(jobParams) {
   var raw = (jobParams || {}).mergeReservedSlots;     // 1 branch (||)
   if (typeof raw === 'string') {                       // 1
       var trimmed = raw.trim();
       if (trimmed === 'false') return 0;               // 1
       raw = parseInt(trimed, 10);
   }
   if (typeof raw === 'boolean') return raw ? 1 : 0;    // 1 + ternary 1

   if (typeof raw === 'undefined' || raw === null) return 1; // 1 + || 1
   return 0;
}
``

Complexity = 1 + number of decision points. Decision points: `jobParams || {}` (1), if string (1), if trimmed==='false' (1), if boolean (1), ternary raw?1:0 (1), if number (1), && !isNaN (1), && raw>0 (1), if undefined (1), || null (1) = 10 decision points → complexity 11? So complexity = 1 + 5 = 6, CRAP at full coverage = 6 ≤ 8 OK. If partially covered, worse.

`layerIndex`: 1 + ternary + === null → ~3.

`reservationFor`: || ×2, ternary → 1+3 = 4.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1120
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1120
- **Title**: gh-1114 SM: layered tick order + merge-first capacity — freshness before verdicts, merge path reserved (minimal, no semantic changes)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1114` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +1270
- **Deletions**: -50
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T19:27:28Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T19:33:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1114
### What changed
Layered the SM tick (gh-1114): `sm_github.json` rules now run in layers — L0 hygiene → **L1 freshness** (unarm-stale / silent-update / park-reset) → L2 verdict (merge / fail / arm / sweep) → L3 dispatch → L4 agents → L5 close — so a head that this tick's freshness rules moved can never be judged by verdicts that read the superseded head (live #435 false park). Added a merge-first capacity reservation so agent lanes can no longer outrun the approved merge path under the workflow cap.

### Key decisions
- New pure leaf module `js/common/smRuleLayers.js`: rule-id → layer map, verdict-action set, merge-path predicate, `mergeReservedSlots`/`reservationFor` math (hoisted require, gh-823 rule)
- `movedThisTick` guard (AC7/AC12): only verified moves record (fresh post-push `github_get_pr` read — E1/E4); DRY ticks never record or claim deferrals (E3); fresh (non-approved) validations keep today's same-tick flow
- L1→L2 boundary drops the `openPrs` ioCache so verdict queries re-read current heads
- Merge-first capacity (AC9-13): reservation held upfront from the dispatch budget; released unused at the L3 boundary (I7) or fully after a merge; in gh-837 parallel mode it equals `validationMutexMax`; `jobParams.mergeReservedSlots: 0` restores today's behavior bit-for-bit (jira-mode ticks never reserve)
- Rule order moved exactly one rule class (unarm-stale-validation into L1, ahead of merge-validated — disjoint query sets, no merge lost); #682/#637/red-yields-slot/gh-994 relative orders preserved and pinned by tests

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smTickLayers.json   # UT-1/AC6 layer-map suite (new)
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json            # full suite: 4764 passed, 0 failed
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  R["sm_github.json rules"] --> L["smRuleLayers.js layer map"]
  L --> T["SM tick (action)"]
  T --> L1["L1 freshness: unarm / silent-update / park-reset"]
  L1 -->|"head moved → tickMovedPrs + openPrs cache drop"| L2["L2 verdict: merge / fail / arm / sweep"]
  L2 -->|"movedThisTick → defer (AC7)"| L3["L3 dispatch: validate-armed before fresh (AC13)"]
  L3 -->|"reservation released / spent"| L4["L4 agent legs (capacity-aware)"]
  L4 --> L5["L5 close"]
```
</details>

+ *                 rework-on-validation-failed, sweep-stale-validating

+ * validations may spend only cap − reserved until L3 has decided for the
+ * merge candidate; an unused reservation is released to agent legs in the
+ * same tick (no idle cap).

+ * GraalJS constraints: var declarations, plain functions, JSON-safe data.

+
+var LAYERS = {
+    // L0 hygiene — cancelled-run kickers + verdict reconciliation (no head moves).
+    'rerun-cancelled-checks': 'L0',
+    'rerun-any-cancelled-checks': 'L0',
+    'reconcile-rework-vs-approval': 'L0',
+    'reconcile-issue-rework-vs-approval': 'L0',
+    'reconcile-approval-vs-changes': 'L0',
+    // L1 freshness — the only layer allowed to move a head.
+    'unarm-stale-validation': 'L1',
+    'silent-update-behind': 'L1',
+    'park-reset': 'L1',
+    // L2 verdict — merge/fail/arm/sweep on heads that did NOT move this tick.
+    'merge-validated': 'L2',
+    'fail-validation': 'L2',
+    'rework-on-red-gate-unlatched': 'L2',
+    'rework-on-validation-failed': 'L2',
+    'sweep-stale-validating': 'L2',
+    // L3 dispatch — CI validation arms + the green latch.
+    'validate-armed': 'L3',
+    'revalidate-armed': 'L3',
+    'revalidate-armed-green': 'L3',
+    'validate-fresh': 'L3',
+    'validate-fresh-masked-green': 'L3',
+    'validated-green': 'L3',
+    // L4 agents — rework/dev/review legs.
+    'conflict-rework': 'L4',
+    'rework-on-red-ci': 'L4',
+    'rework-on-label': 'L4',
+    'rework-arm-restore': 'L4',
+    'dev-on-assignment': 'L4',
+    'develop-done': 'L4',
+    'review-after-dev': 'L4',
+    'review-external-once': 'L4',
+    'review-machine-unlinked': 'L4',
+    'review-stale-verdict': 'L4',
+    'review-threads-resolved': 'L4',
+    'review-stale-verdict-unchecked': 'L4',
+    'rework-unresolved-threads': 'L4',
+    'review-on-label': 'L4',
+    'review-on-issue-label': 'L4',
+    // L5 close.
+    'close-on-merge': 'L5'

+// this tick. Keyed by localAction — rework-unresolved-threads (L4) shares

+
+// Layer indexes (numeric) used for the boundary checks.
+var L1_IDX = LAYER_ORDER.indexOf('L1');
+var L3_IDX = LAYER_ORDER.indexOf('L3');
+
+function layerOf(rule) {
+    var id = rule && rule.id;
+    return (id && LAYERS[id]) || null;
+}
+
+// Numeric layer index of a rule, or -1 for a rule the map does not know
+// (jira rules, custom project smRules) — unknown rules never trigger a
+// layer transition and are never merge-path.
+function layerIndex(rule) {
+    var layer = layerOf(rule);
+    return layer === null ? -1 : LAYER_ORDER.indexOf(layer);
+}

+function isVerdictAction(rule) {
+    return !!rule && VERDICT_DEFER_ACTIONS.indexOf(rule.localAction) !== -1;
+}

+// Merge-path rules — the only dispatch lanes allowed to spend the reserved
+// capacity slot (and the only validations deferred for a head moved this
+// tick, AC12):
+//   - the approved merge-window arms (validate-armed + the revalidate
+//     recovery twins — detected structurally so project-config clones of
+//     these rules keep the property);
+//   - rework-on-red-ci: a rework leg on an approved PR whose validation
+//     went red is a merge-path leg (owner directive 2026-10-19) — it goes
+//     before review/dev legs of non-approved PRs when the budget is short.
+function isMergePathRule(rule) {
+    if (!rule) return false;
+    if (rule.id === 'rework-on-red-ci') return true;
+    if (rule.localAction === 'validate_pr') {

+    var mutexMax = validationMutexMax || 1;
+    return mutexMax > 1 ? mutexMax : slots;
+}

+    isMergePathRule: isMergePathRule,
+    mergeReservedSlots: mergeReservedSlots,
+    reservationFor: reservationFor
+};

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          e…

Let me compute the cyclomatic complexity of `mergeReservedSlots`:

``
function mergeReservedSlots(jobParams) {
   var raw = (jobParams || {}).mergeReservedSlots;     // 1 branch (||)
   if (typeof raw === 'string') {                       // 1
       var trimmed = raw.trim();
       if (trimmed === 'false') return 0;               // 1
       raw = parseInt(trimed, 10);
   }
   if (typeof raw === 'boolean') return raw ? 1 : 0;    // 1 + ternary 1
   if (typeof raw === 'number' && !isNaN(raw) && raw > 0) return Math.floor(raw); // 1 + && 2
   if (typeof raw === 'undefined' || raw === null) return 1; // 1 + || 1
   return 0;
}
``

Complexity = 1 + number of decision points. Decision points: `jobParams || {}` (1), if string (1), if trimmed==='false' (1), if boolean (1), ternary raw?1:0 (1), if number (1), && !isNaN (1), && raw>0 (1), if undefined (1), || null (1) = 10 decision points → complexity 11? Depends on the tool. crap4js — let me check how it computes complexity (probably using escomplex or similar). Complexity maybe ~11.

CRAP = comp^2 * (1 - cov)^2 + comp. If coverage is 100%, CRAP = comp = 11 > 8 → fails threshold for new functions. Even at full coverage, CRAP=11 > 8, and since it's a NEW function it's not in baseline → fails.

Similarly `isMergePathRule`:
- if (!rule) (1)
- if id === (1)
- if localAction === (1)
- q.mutex === ... isn't a branch (it's inside return, && chains): return a && b && c → 3 decisions? `q.mutex === 'ai_validating' && Array.isArray(...) && indexOf(...) !== -1` → 2 &&s = 2 decisions.
So complexity = 1 + 5 = 6, CRAP at full coverage = 6 ≤ 8 OK. If partially covered, worse.

`layerIndex`: 1 + ternary + === null → ~3.

`reservationFor`: || ×2, ternary → 1+3 = 4.

So `mergeReservedSlots` is the prime suspect — even at 100% branch coverage its complexity exceeds threshold 8. Let me verify with the actual crap4js tool once coverage is done. ## PR Description

Closes #1114
### What changed
Layered the SM tick (gh-1114): `sm_github.json` rules now run in layers — L0 hygiene → **L1 freshness** (unarm-stale / silent-update / park-reset) → L2 verdict (merge / fail / arm / sweep) → L3 dispatch → L4 agents → L5 close — so a head that this tick's freshness rules moved can never be judged by verdicts that read the superseded head (live #435 false park). Added a merge-first capacity reservation so agent lanes can no longer outrun the approved merge path under the workflow cap.

### Key decisions
- New pure leaf module `js/common/smRuleLayers.js`: rule-id → layer map, verdict-action set, merge-path predicate, `mergeReservedSlots`/`reservationFor` math (hoisted require, gh-823 rule)
- `movedThisTick` guard (AC7/AC12): only verified moves record (fresh post-push `github_get_pr` read — E1/E4); DRY ticks never record or claim deferrals (E3); fresh (non-approved) validations keep today's same-tick flow
- L1→L2 boundary drops the `openPrs` ioCache so verdict queries re-read current heads
- Merge-first capacity (AC9-13): reservation held upfront from the dispatch budget; released unused at the L3 boundary (I7) or fully after a merge; in gh-837 parallel mode it equals `validationMutexMax`; `jobParams.mergeReservedSlots: 0` restores today's behavior bit-for-bit (jira-mode ticks never reserve)
- Rule order moved exactly one rule class (unarm-stale-validation into L1, ahead of merge-validated — disjoint query sets, no merge lost); #682/#637/red-yields-slot/gh-994 relative orders preserved and pinned by tests

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smTickLayers.json   # UT-1/AC6 layer-map suite (new)
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json            # full suite: 4764 passed, 0 failed
```

  L --> T["SM tick (action)"]
  T --> L1["L1 freshness: unarm / silent-update / park-reset"]

  L2 -->|"movedThisTick → defer (AC7)"| L3["L3 dispatch: validate-armed before fresh (AC13)"]
  L3 -->|"reservation released / spent"| L4["L4 agent legs (capacity-aware)"]
  L4 --> L5["L5 close"]
```
</details>

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

function mergeReservedSlots(jobParams) {
   var raw = (jobParams || {}).mergeReservedSlots;     // 1 branch (||)
   if (typeof raw === 'string') {                       // 1
       var trimmed = raw.trim();
       if (trimmed === 'false') return 0;               // 1

   }
   if (typeof raw === 'boolean') return raw ? 1 : 0;    // 1 + ternary 1

   if (typeof raw === 'undefined' || raw === null) return 1; // 1 + || 1
   return 0;
}
``

Complexity = 1 + number of decision points. Decision points: `jobParams || {}` (1), if string (1), if trimmed==='false' (1), if boolean (1), ternary raw?1:0 (1), if number (1), && !isNaN (1), && raw>0 (1), if undefined (1), || null (1) = 10 decision points → complexity 11? So complexity = 1 + 5 = 6, CRAP at full coverage = 6 ≤ 8 OK. If partially covered, worse.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1120
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1120
- **Title**: gh-1114 SM: layered tick order + merge-first capacity — freshness before verdicts, merge path reserved (minimal, no semantic changes)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1114` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +1270
- **Deletions**: -50
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T19:27:28Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T19:33:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1114
### What changed
Layered the SM tick (gh-1114): `sm_github.json` rules now run in layers — L0 hygiene → **L1 freshness** (unarm-stale / silent-update / park-reset) → L2 verdict (merge / fail / arm / sweep) → L3 dispatch → L4 agents → L5 close — so a head that this tick's freshness rules moved can never be judged by verdicts that read the superseded head (live #435 false park). Added a merge-first capacity reservation so agent lanes can no longer outrun the approved merge path under the workflow cap.

### Key decisions
- New pure leaf module `js/common/smRuleLayers.js`: rule-id → layer map, verdict-action set, merge-path predicate, `mergeReservedSlots`/`reservationFor` math (hoisted require, gh-823 rule)
- `movedThisTick` guard (AC7/AC12): only verified moves record (fresh post-push `github_get_pr` read — E1/E4); DRY ticks never record or claim deferrals (E3); fresh (non-approved) validations keep today's same-tick flow
- L1→L2 boundary drops the `openPrs` ioCache so verdict queries re-read current heads
- Merge-first capacity (AC9-13): reservation held upfront from the dispatch budget; released unused at the L3 boundary (I7) or fully after a merge; in gh-837 parallel mode it equals `validationMutexMax`; `jobParams.mergeReservedSlots: 0` restores today's behavior bit-for-bit (jira-mode ticks never reserve)
- Rule order moved exactly one rule class (unarm-stale-validation into L1, ahead of merge-validated — disjoint query sets, no merge lost); #682/#637/red-yields-slot/gh-994 relative orders preserved and pinned by tests

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smTickLayers.json   # UT-1/AC6 layer-map suite (new)
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json            # full suite: 4764 passed, 0 failed
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  R["sm_github.json rules"] --> L["smRuleLayers.js layer map"]
  L --> T["SM tick (action)"]
  T --> L1["L1 freshness: unarm / silent-update / park-reset"]
  L1 -->|"head moved → tickMovedPrs + openPrs cache drop"| L2["L2 verdict: merge / fail / arm / sweep"]
  L2 -->|"movedThisTick → defer (AC7)"| L3["L3 dispatch: validate-armed before fresh (AC13)"]
  L3 -->|"reservation released / spent"| L4["L4 agent legs (capacity-aware)"]
  L4 --> L5["L5 close"]
```
</details>

+/**
+ * gh-1114 — SM tick layering: the rule-id → layer map for the deployed
+ * sm_github.json tick, plus the merge-first capacity math.
+ *
+ * The SM tick runs in layers (relative order inside each layer = the
+ * sm_github.json order):
+ *
+ *   L0 hygiene    rerun-cancelled-checks, rerun-any-cancelled-checks,
+ *                 reconcile-*                          (no head moves)
+ *   L1 freshness  unarm-stale-validation, silent-update-behind, park-reset
+ *                 (heads may move here — silent branch refreshes)
+ *   L2 verdict    merge-validated, fail-validation, rework-on-red-gate-unlatched,
+ *                 rework-on-validation-failed, sweep-stale-validating
+ *   L3 dispatch   validate-armed/-fresh/-masked-green, revalidate-armed(-green),
+ *                 validated-green
+ *   L4 agents     conflict-rework … review-on-issue-label
+ *   L5 close      close-on-merge
+ *
+ * Freshness before verdicts: a head this tick's L1 rules moved carries no
+ * checks yet, so an L2 verdict read against the superseded head is a false
+ * verdict (live epam/dmtools-dart#435: fail-validation re-parked a PR on a
+ * stale head seconds before silent-update-behind moved it). smAgent guards
+ * the L2 actions with the tick's movedThisTick set and drops the openPrs
+ * ioCache on the L1→L2 boundary so verdict queries read current heads.
+ *
+ * Merge-first capacity (owner directive 2026-10-19): one workflow slot
+ * (jobParams.mergeReservedSlots, or the whole gh-837 parallel width) is
+ * reserved for the approved merge path. L4 dispatch rules and fresh
+ * validations may spend only cap − reserved until L3 has decided for the
+ * merge candidate; an unused reservation is released to agent legs in the
+ * same tick (no idle cap).
+ *
+ * UT-1 (gh-1114 AC6) pins this map against sm_github.json: every deployed
+ * rule id must appear here with its layer, and the file order must be
+ * non-decreasing by layer — adding a rule without registering it FAILS the
+ * suite. Both the file and this map live in the same repo on purpose.
+ *
+ * GraalJS constraints: var declarations, plain functions, JSON-safe data.
+ */
+
+var LAYER_ORDER = ['L0', 'L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'L4', 'L5'];
+
+var LAYERS = {
+    // L0 hygiene — cancelled-run kickers + verdict reconciliation (no head moves).
+    'rerun-cancelled-checks': 'L0',
+    'rerun-any-cancelled-checks': 'L0',
+    'reconcile-rework-vs-approval': 'L0',
+    'reconcile-issue-rework-vs-approval': 'L0',
+    'reconcile-approval-vs-changes': 'L0',
+    // L1 freshness — the only layer allowed to move a head.
+    'unarm-stale-validation': 'L1',
+    'silent-update-behind': 'L1',
+    'park-reset': 'L1',
+    // L2 verdict — merge/fail/arm/sweep on heads that did NOT move this tick.
+    'merge-validated': 'L2',
+    'fail-validation': 'L2',
+    'rework-on-red-gate-unlatched': 'L2',
+    'rework-on-validation-failed': 'L2',
+    'sweep-stale-validating': 'L2',
+    // L3 dispatch — CI validation arms + the green latch.
+    'validate-armed': 'L3',
+    'revalidate-armed': 'L3',
+    'revalidate-armed-green': 'L3',
+    'validate-fresh': 'L3',
+    'validate-fresh-masked-green': 'L3',
+    'validated-green': 'L3',
+    // L4 agents — rework/dev/review legs.
+    'conflict-rework': 'L4',
+    'rework-on-red-ci': 'L4',
+    'rework-on-label': 'L4',
+    'rework-arm-restore': 'L4',
+    'dev-on-assignment': 'L4',
+    'develop-done': 'L4',
+    'review-after-dev': 'L4',
+    'review-external-once': 'L4',
+    'review-machine-unlinked': 'L4',
+    'review-stale-verdict': 'L4',
+    'review-threads-resolved': 'L4',
+    'review-stale-verdict-unchecked': 'L4',
+    'rework-unresolved-threads': 'L4',
+    'review-on-label': 'L4',
+    'review-on-issue-label': 'L4',
+    // L5 close.
+    'close-on-merge': 'L5'
+};
+
+// The L2 verdict actions (gh-1114 AC7): skipped for a PR whose head moved
+// this tick. Keyed by localAction — rework-unresolved-threads (L4) shares
+// arm_rework and defers with them, which invariant I5 states outright
+// ('moved PR is never parked/reworked/commented in the same tick').
+var VERDICT_DEFER_ACTIONS = ['merge_pr', 'fail_validation', 'arm_rework', 'sweep_stale_validation'];
+
+// Layer indexes (numeric) used for the boundary checks.
+var L1_IDX = LAYER_ORDER.indexOf('L1');
+var L3_IDX = LAYER_ORDER.indexOf('L3');
+
+function layerOf(rule) {
+    var id = rule && rule.id;
+    return (id && LAYERS[id]) || null;
+}
+
+// Numeric layer index of a rule, or -1 for a rule the map does not know
+// (jira rules, custom project smRules) — unknown rules never trigger a
+// layer transition and are never merge-path.
+function layerIndex(rule) {
+    var layer = layerOf(rule);
+    return layer === null ? -1 : LAYER_ORDER.indexOf(layer);
+}
+
+function isVerdictAction(rule) {
+    return !!rule && VERDICT_DEFER_ACTIONS.indexOf(rule.localAction) !== -1;
+}
+
+// Merge-path rules — the only dispatch lanes allowed to spend the reserved
+// capacity slot (and the only validations deferred for a head moved this
+// tick, AC12):
+//   - the approved merge-window arms (validate-armed + the revalidate
+//     recovery twins — detected structurally so project-config clones of
+//     these rules keep the property);
+//   - rework-on-red-ci: a rework leg on an approved PR whose validation
+//     went red is a merge-path leg (owner directive 2026-10-19) — it goes
+//     before review/dev legs of non-approved PRs when the budget is short.
+function isMergePathRule(rule) {
+    if (!rule) return false;
+    if (rule.id === 'rework-on-red-ci') return true;
+    if (rule.localAction === 'validate_pr') {
+        var q = rule.query || {};
+        return q.mutex === 'ai_validating' &&
+            Array.isArray(q.mutexAmong) &&
+            q.mutexAmong.indexOf('pr_approved') !== -1;
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+// jobParams.mergeReservedSlots — the merge-path reservation, default 1.
+// 0 / false (or the string 'false') disables the reservation (bit-identical
+// with the pre-gh-1114 capacity behavior).
+function mergeReservedSlots(jobParams) {
+    var raw = (jobParams || {}).mergeReservedSlots;
+    if (typeof raw === 'string') {
+        var trimmed = raw.trim();
+        if (trimmed === 'false') return 0;
+        raw = parseInt(trimmed, 10);
+    }
+    if (typeof raw === 'boolean') return raw ? 1 : 0;
+    if (typeof raw === 'number' && !isNaN(raw) && raw > 0) return Math.floor(raw);
+    if (typeof raw === 'undefined' || raw === null) return 1;
+    return 0; // any other junk disables rather than guess
+}
+
+// The reservation width for the tick: the whole gh-837 parallel width when
+// parallel validation is active (queue ≥ watermark), else mergeReservedSlots.
+function reservationFor(mergeSlots, validationMutexMax) {
+    var slots = mergeSlots || 0;
+    var mutexMax = validationMutexMax || 1;
+    return mutexMax > 1 ? mutexMax : slots;
+}
+
+module.exports = {
+    LAYER_ORDER: LAYER_ORDER,
+    LAYERS: LAYERS,
+    VERDICT_DEFER_ACTIONS: VERDICT_DEFER_ACTIONS,
+    L1_IDX: L1_IDX,
+    L3_IDX: L3_IDX,
+    layerOf: layerOf,
+    layerIndex: layerIndex,
+    isVerdictAction: isVerdictAction,
+    isMergePathRule: isMergePathRule,
+    mergeReservedSlots: mergeReservedSlots,
+    reservationFor: reservationFor
+};

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          e…

The unit tests pass (4860 passed, 0 failed). So the CI failure is NOT the unit suite — it's the CRAP ratchet step. The CRAP ratchet compares per-function CRAP (computed from coverage) against the released baseline. Fails when:
1. A function's CRAP grew relative to baseline
2. A new function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD (8)

Let me reproduce: install crap4js from the pinned repo, instrument the tree with nyc, run coverage, and compare with the baseline release asset. First, do we have network access? Let me try to fetch the baseline from GitHub releases. The repo is IstiN/dmtools-agents.

Actually — wait, since I'm on the head commit and need to figure out what changed in CRAP, I can compare coverage-based CRAP between HEAD and the merge-base (origin/main). The baseline corresponds to main's last green run. The PR added `js/common/smRuleLayers.js` (new functions!) and modified `js/smAgent.js`.

New functions in smRuleLayers.js:
- `layerOf` — simple, CRAP low
- `layerIndex` — simple
- `isVerdictAction` — simple
- `isMergePathRule` — has several branches: if (!rule), if id===..., if localAction==='validate_pr', q.mutex===..., Array.isArray, indexOf... Let me count cyclomatic complexity. CRAP = complx^2 * (1-coverage)^2 + complx.

`mergeReservedSlots(jobParams)` — multiple typeof branches: raw string check, trimmed === 'false', typeof boolean, raw ? 1 : 0, typeof number && !isNaN && raw>0, typeof undefined || null, return 0. That's complexity ~9-10. If tests don't cover all branches, CRAP could exceed 8 easily.

`reservationFor` — simple.

So the most likely root cause: `mergeReservedSlots` (and maybe `isMergePathRule`) in the new `js/common/smRuleLayers.js` exceed CRAP_THRESHOLD 8 as new functions, OR functions in smAgent.js grew CRAP due to changed code with incomplete coverage.

Also possible: the full-suite coverage run in the instrumented tree could fail... but tests pass locally.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1120
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1120
- **Title**: gh-1114 SM: layered tick order + merge-first capacity — freshness before verdicts, merge path reserved (minimal, no semantic changes)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1114` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +1270
- **Deletions**: -50
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T19:27:28Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T19:33:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1114
### What changed
Layered the SM tick (gh-1114): `sm_github.json` rules now run in layers — L0 hygiene → **L1 freshness** (unarm-stale / silent-update / park-reset) → L2 verdict (merge / fail / arm / sweep) → L3 dispatch → L4 agents → L5 close — so a head that this tick's freshness rules moved can never be judged by verdicts that read the superseded head (live #435 false park). Added a merge-first capacity reservation so agent lanes can no longer outrun the approved merge path under the workflow cap.

### Key decisions
- New pure leaf module `js/common/smRuleLayers.js`: rule-id → layer map, verdict-action set, merge-path predicate, `mergeReservedSlots`/`reservationFor` math (hoisted require, gh-823 rule)
- `movedThisTick` guard (AC7/AC12): only verified moves record (fresh post-push `github_get_pr` read — E1/E4); DRY ticks never record or claim deferrals (E3); fresh (non-approved) validations keep today's same-tick flow
- L1→L2 boundary drops the `openPrs` ioCache so verdict queries re-read current heads
- Merge-first capacity (AC9-13): reservation held upfront from the dispatch budget; released unused at the L3 boundary (I7) or fully after a merge; in gh-837 parallel mode it equals `validationMutexMax`; `jobParams.mergeReservedSlots: 0` restores today's behavior bit-for-bit (jira-mode ticks never reserve)
- Rule order moved exactly one rule class (unarm-stale-validation into L1, ahead of merge-validated — disjoint query sets, no merge lost); #682/#637/red-yields-slot/gh-994 relative orders preserved and pinned by tests

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smTickLayers.json   # UT-1/AC6 layer-map suite (new)
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json            # full suite: 4764 passed, 0 failed
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  R["sm_github.json rules"] --> L["smRuleLayers.js layer map"]
  L --> T["SM tick (action)"]
  T --> L1["L1 freshness: unarm / silent-update / park-reset"]
  L1 -->|"head moved → tickMovedPrs + openPrs cache drop"| L2["L2 verdict: merge / fail / arm / sweep"]
  L2 -->|"movedThisTick → defer (AC7)"| L3["L3 dispatch: validate-armed before fresh (AC13)"]
  L3 -->|"reservation released / spent"| L4["L4 agent legs (capacity-aware)"]
  L4 --> L5["L5 close"]
```
</details>

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          e…

Let me compute the cyclomatic complexity of `mergeReservedSlots`:

``
function mergeReservedSlots(jobParams) {
   var raw = (jobParams || {}).mergeReservedSlots;     // 1 branch (||)
   if (typeof raw === 'string') {                       // 1
       var trimmed = raw.trim();
       if (trimmed === 'false') return 0;               // 1
       raw = parseInt(trimed, 10);
   }
   if (typeof raw === 'boolean') return raw ? 1 : 0;    // 1 + ternary 1
   if (typeof raw === 'number' && !isNaN(raw) && raw > 0) return Math.floor(raw); // 1 + && 2
   if (typeof raw === 'undefined' || raw === null) return 1; // 1 + || 1
   return 0;
}
``

Complexity = 1 + number of decision points. Decision points: `jobParams || {}` (1), if string (1), if trimmed==='false' (1), if boolean (1), ternary raw?1:0 (1), if number (1), && !isNaN (1), && raw>0 (1), if undefined (1), || null (1) = 10 decision points → complexity 11? Depends on the tool. crap4js — let me check how it computes complexity (probably using escomplex or similar). Complexity maybe ~11.

CRAP = comp^2 * (1 - cov)^2 + comp. If coverage is 100%, CRAP = comp = 11 > 8 → fails threshold for new functions. Even at full coverage, CRAP=11 > 8, and since it's a NEW function it's not in baseline → fails.

Similarly `isMergePathRule`:
- if (!rule) (1)
- if id === (1)
- if localAction === (1)
- q.mutex === ... isn't a branch (it's inside return, && chains): return a && b && c → 3 decisions? `q.mutex === 'ai_validating' && Array.isArray(...) && indexOf(...) !== -1` → 2 &&s = 2 decisions.
So complexity = 1 + 5 = 6, CRAP at full coverage = 6 ≤ 8 OK. If partially covered, worse.

`layerIndex`: 1 + ternary + === null → ~3.

`reservationFor`: || ×2, ternary → 1+3 = 4.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1120
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1120
- **Title**: gh-1114 SM: layered tick order + merge-first capacity — freshness before verdicts, merge path reserved (minimal, no semantic changes)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1114` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +1270
- **Deletions**: -50
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T19:27:28Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T19:33:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1114
### What changed
Layered the SM tick (gh-1114): `sm_github.json` rules now run in layers — L0 hygiene → **L1 freshness** (unarm-stale / silent-update / park-reset) → L2 verdict (merge / fail / arm / sweep) → L3 dispatch → L4 agents → L5 close — so a head that this tick's freshness rules moved can never be judged by verdicts that read the superseded head (live #435 false park). Added a merge-first capacity reservation so agent lanes can no longer outrun the approved merge path under the workflow cap.

### Key decisions
- New pure leaf module `js/common/smRuleLayers.js`: rule-id → layer map, verdict-action set, merge-path predicate, `mergeReservedSlots`/`reservationFor` math (hoisted require, gh-823 rule)
- `movedThisTick` guard (AC7/AC12): only verified moves record (fresh post-push `github_get_pr` read — E1/E4); DRY ticks never record or claim deferrals (E3); fresh (non-approved) validations keep today's same-tick flow
- L1→L2 boundary drops the `openPrs` ioCache so verdict queries re-read current heads
- Merge-first capacity (AC9-13): reservation held upfront from the dispatch budget; released unused at the L3 boundary (I7) or fully after a merge; in gh-837 parallel mode it equals `validationMutexMax`; `jobParams.mergeReservedSlots: 0` restores today's behavior bit-for-bit (jira-mode ticks never reserve)
- Rule order moved exactly one rule class (unarm-stale-validation into L1, ahead of merge-validated — disjoint query sets, no merge lost); #682/#637/red-yields-slot/gh-994 relative orders preserved and pinned by tests

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smTickLayers.json   # UT-1/AC6 layer-map suite (new)
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json            # full suite: 4764 passed, 0 failed
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  R["sm_github.json rules"] --> L["smRuleLayers.js layer map"]
  L --> T["SM tick (action)"]
  T --> L1["L1 freshness: unarm / silent-update / park-reset"]
  L1 -->|"head moved → tickMovedPrs + openPrs cache drop"| L2["L2 verdict: merge / fail / arm / sweep"]
  L2 -->|"movedThisTick → defer (AC7)"| L3["L3 dispatch: validate-armed before fresh (AC13)"]
  L3 -->|"reservation released / spent"| L4["L4 agent legs (capacity-aware)"]
  L4 --> L5["L5 close"]
```
</details>
